messages:
Ana (partnerships): quick sync — we need a lightweight framework for private offers across cloud marketplaces + hardware bundles. goal: consistent guardrails so sales/partners don't over-discount.
Mike S (sales): +1. can we standardize % off by commit size? sales keep getting asks for custom comps.
Jordan P (revops): prefer formula not fixed % — depends on ARR velocity and renewal uplift. but we can publish recommended bands.
Priya R (partner-eng): for SI co-sells we usually add implementation credits. those should be explicit in the offer template.
Eli (solutions): also flag that some hardware promo combos (e.g., GPU credits) are time-limited — need expiry in offer text.
marketplace-bot: draft_private_offer_v2 created: /docs/marketplace/private-offer-template.md
Ana (partnerships): sharing a quick draft below — please comment. use short replies.
Ana (partnerships): ```
Private Offer — recommended bands (example)
Tier A: Commit >= $50k/yr -> 15% off list + 5% marketing credit + 1x co-sell intro
Tier B: Commit >= $250k/yr -> 25% off list + 10% marketing credit + priority enablement (4 eng hrs)
Tier C: Commit >= $1M/yr -> 35% off list + 15% marketing credit + dedicated success SLA + 12 eng hrs
Renewal uplift target: aim for +12-18% at renewal with 12-mo term and 10% step-up in year 2
Hardware partner add-on: stackable credits up to 10% of commit (must be explicitly approved)
SI integration support: implementation credits not to exceed 20% of initial contract value for first year
Conditions: 12-mo minimum, non-transferrable credits, auto-expire 90d after term end unless renewed
```
Mike S (sales): those bands look reasonable. ask: can we allow sales to request one-off escalations (yes/no flow)?
Jordan P (revops): allow one-off escalations only with RevOps + Partnerships sign-off. require a short memo: business case + expected ARR.
Priya R (partner-eng): for joint announcements with hardware partners we should require co-marketing commitment for Tier B+. otherwise lower discount.
Eli (solutions): onboarding timeline SLA should be tied to co-sell credits. if partner can't meet enablement window, we pull credits.
Ana (partnerships): action items: 1) Jordan to codify sign-off workflow in the template; 2) Priya to add co-marketing clause; 3) Mike to collect 3 live examples from sales; 4) Eli to draft enablement SLA snippet.
Jordan P (revops): noted. I'll add a small approval matrix:
```
Escalation approvals:
< $100k -> APM + Partnerships
$100k-$500k -> RevOps mgr + Partnerships lead
> $500k -> CRO + Partnerships VP sign-off
```
Mike S (sales): can we add a renewal sweetener — e.g., 5% credit if renews within 60d? helps retention.
Jordan P (revops): yes, define as "early renewal credit" limited to 1-time use, applied as invoice credit, not stackable with other promos.
Priya R (partner-eng): question re private offers in cloud marketplaces: some marketplaces block stacking vendor credits and partner credits. need legal check.
Ana (partnerships): Priya — can you flag which markets (AWS/GCP/Azure) have stacking issues and we hide stacking in those marketplaces?
Priya R (partner-eng): will do. initial note: AWS private offers: generally allow vendor credits but partner credits vary by region/partner account.
Eli (solutions): FYI some hardware partners prefer fixed USD rebates vs % — include a conversion table in template.
Ana (partnerships): good point. add this conversion table example to the doc.
marketplace-bot: private_offer_template_v3 published to /docs/marketplace/private-offer-template.md (rev 3)
Mike S (sales): cool — can we run this by 2 pilot deals next week? I'll nominate two reps.
Ana (partnerships): yes — nominate reps + deals by EOD Tue. we'll iterate after pilots. :thumbsup:
Jordan P (revops): putting timeline: pilot -> revops review (3 days) -> legal check (5 days) -> finalize template.
Priya R (partner-eng): tagging hardware partner lead for awareness: @NVIDIA-svcs (will DM separately).
Eli (solutions): thanks all. short meeting later? 15m sync tomorrow to align on pilots.
Ana (partnerships): scheduled 15m tomorrow 10:15 PT. agenda in calendar.
